text:
Noah Kim: Postmortem follow-up: we saw three small incidents where regression gaps allowed a fallback to a lower-capacity variant during traffic spikes. We need a concrete gating plan so model swaps and canary rollouts don't regress production.

Eva Martinez: Proposed checklist to implement in 2 weeks: 1) add a regression gate that requires nightly replay passes for the last 7 days before any model swap; 2) create a promptset that reproduces long-prefix eviction edge-cases; 3) add a CI matrix that includes streaming vs non-streaming.

Liam O'Connor: I can take the replay job. Plan: build a lightweight runner that replays sampled traces around scale events and fails fast if fallback_rate > 1%. Will run nightly in staging for 14 days. Repro command: `./tools/replay --trace traces/incidents/last-7d.json --speed 4x`.

Priya Rao: I'll draft the gating policy text for the console: require 7-day nightly green, p95 not increased >10%, and fallback_rate < 0.5%. I'll also add a runbook section for oncall to abort swaps if gate fails.

Noah Kim: Owner recap: Liam -> replay job + CI (due Wed), Eva -> promptset + eval assertions (due Thu), Priya -> gating policy, console copy, and runbook (due Fri). ops-bot create follow-up ticket and schedule a 20m sync next week.

ops-bot: Created ticket #INC-4488 "regression-gate: nightly replay + promptset + runbook" assigned to Noah Kim, due 2025-03-05. Sync scheduled: 2025-02-20 15:00 UTC.

Eva Martinez: Promptset notes: include 20 short/long pairs, include streaming chunk boundaries, and assert token continuity. Quick example snippet: ```yaml
- name: long_prefix_evict_01
  input: "<ctx>"
  expect: contains("continuation")
```

Liam O'Connor: CI detail: `ci/jobs/replay_gate.yml` with matrix {environment: staging, stress}. Failures should post a failure message to #eng-ml and open an auto-ticket if 3 consecutive nights fail.

Priya Rao: Runbook excerpt: when gate fails, pause any ongoing rollouts, escalate to release lead, collect last 72h traces, and run targeted chaos (kill GPU) to validate fallback path.

Noah Kim: Also want a low-effort chaos cadence: one small chaos drill per quarter targeting eviction policy; Jordan from infra can run it. We'll add the cadence to the ticket.

Eva Martinez: I'll open the promptset PR after lunch: https://github.com/redwood/repro/pull/789 (draft). Includes assertions for variant selection.

Liam O'Connor: I'll wire the nightly job and add dashboards: nightly_pass_rate, fallback_rate, p95_delta. Linking dashboards in INC-4488.

Priya Rao: Final note: make sure alert routing includes product-owners so we don't have silent rollbacks.

Noah Kim: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers DM me. We'll confirm progress at the scheduled sync. :thumbsup:
